messages:
sam: Hey all — first day! Trying to finish my dev env: using macOS (arm, Ventura), running code in a VS Code devcontainer that uses Nix + Docker. I want to manage runtimes with asdf inside the container, but my SSH agent and GPG (for git commits) aren't forwarding. Also node installed by asdf seems invisible to the host, and port-forwarding from container -> host for an internal dashboard is flaky. Anyone got a recent working setup?

lina: welcome!! :tada: we do a similar stack in infra. few tips: 1) run SSH agent on host and forward via Docker socket into container, 2) for gpg use gpg-agent with /run/gnupg and pinentry-mac on host, 3) prefer installing asdf inside the container not on host so container is hermetic.

mike: +1 to lina. For VS Code devcontainers I mount the socket: `-v $SSH_AUTH_SOCK:$SSH_AUTH_SOCK` and set `env: SSH_AUTH_SOCK: ${env:SSH_AUTH_SOCK}` in devcontainer.json. That made `ssh-add -L` work inside.

sam: thanks — I tried mounting SSH_AUTH_SOCK but the path inside container was different. Do you usually keep same absolute path or symlink it?

lina: symlink works. we do this in Dockerfile entrypoint: ```bash
mkdir -p /ssh-sock && ln -s $SSH_AUTH_SOCK /ssh-sock/agent.sock && export SSH_AUTH_SOCK=/ssh-sock/agent.sock
```
keeps container path stable.

mike: for GPG I forward the agent similarly and set `GPG_AGENT_INFO` or use gpg `--use-agent`. On mac, install `gpg-suite` on host and forward the socket to container. If using pinentry issues, `export GPG_TTY=$(tty)` inside container helps when running commands interactively.

sam: awesome. how about asdf + nix conflict? devcontainer uses Nix to provide system deps, but asdf installs in `~/.asdf`. When I install node via asdf it sometimes isn't on PATH in non-login shells.

lina: two approaches: 1) add asdf init hooks in `/etc/profile.d/asdf.sh` inside container so all shells source it; or 2) bake the needed runtimes into the Nix derivation for the devcontainer so you don't need asdf at runtime. We prefer 2 for reproducibility, but some devs like asdf for easy switching.

jess: fwiw we have a tiny helper script in repo `scripts/setup-dev.sh` that symlinks `~/.asdf` to `/workspace/.asdf` and adds the init to `.bashrc`. It also patches `.gitconfig` to use `gpg.program` pointing to forwarded gpg. Ping me and I can open a PR to copy it into your branch.

sam: that would be super helpful, thanks jess. last thing: port forwarding — I'm running the internal dashboard on port 8080 in container but can't hit it on host. devcontainer.json has `forwardPorts: [8080]` but no luck.

mike: check Docker run args: if you bind to 0.0.0.0 inside container it's reachable. sometimes Nix derivation uses firewalling. also VS Code forwards via its own tunnel; try `localhost:8080` and `127.0.0.1:8080`. if using Docker Desktop on mac with Podman-ish settings watch the host network mode.

sam: ah I had the app bound to `localhost` inside the container. changed to `0.0.0.0` and now it's reachable. thanks! :relieved:

sam: done — pinged jess for the script PR, will update if I hit anything else. really appreciate the quick help :)
